Flushes the CDN cache of the website and returns the task.

Sets a new SFTP password for the website and returns the task. The password needs 9 to 30 alphanumeric characters, with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter and one digit.
Exports a full backup of the website, files and database, and returns the task. The download links are sent by email.
